jobs.description:
**Base Location:** For this role, we require successful applicants to be based from one of our Scottish locations and you'll be expected to spend 50% of your working week in the office or on site. Office locations \- Glasgow, Aberdeen, Perth, Inverness


**Salary:** £51,600 \- £77,400 \+ car / car allowance \+ performance\-related bonus \+ a range of benefits to support your finances, wellbeing and family.


**Working Pattern:** Permanent \| Full Time \| Flexible First options available



**The role**



SSEN Transmission Onshore AC are currently recruiting for an experienced Civil Project Engineer to support our growing portfolio of projects throughout the delivery of high profile, high value and technically complex projects on the Electricity Transmission network in Scotland.



The role is responsible for taking projects from initial development and design, through to delivery, commissioning and hand over to operations.


**You will**



* Develop and deliver civil engineering solutions across some of the UK's largest transmission and substation projects, helping enable the transition to a low\-carbon energy future.
* Support the development of engineering designs from concept through to construction and commissioning, covering areas such as site development, earthworks, drainage, access arrangements and associated infrastructure.
* Define engineering scopes, prepare technical specifications, evaluate tenders and manage specialist engineering services to support successful project delivery.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams throughout the project lifecycle, contributing to design reviews, engineering assurance, HAZID and risk assessment activities, and the resolution of complex technical challenges.
* Promote a strong safety culture by applying CDM requirements, engineering standards and industry best practice, while identifying and managing engineering risks and opportunities.


**You have**


* A degree, HND, or equivalent qualification in Civil Engineering, or substantial relevant industry experience, supported by strong technical knowledge of industry standards, specifications, and the Construction (Design and Management) Regulations (CDM).
* Experience developing and delivering civil engineering solutions for major infrastructure, utilities, energy, construction or industrial projects.
* A strong understanding of civil engineering principles including earthworks, drainage, geotechnical and structural engineering, together with knowledge of relevant design standards, regulations and engineering assurance processes.
* Experience working across multidisciplinary teams, using digital engineering tools and engaging effectively with stakeholders to support project delivery.
* The ability to manage technical risk and support engineering decision\-making throughout the project lifecycle. For Senior Civil Engineer opportunities, you'll also have experience providing technical leadership, mentoring engineers and leading complex engineering workstreams.


We welcome applications from candidates both within and outside the electricity transmission industry. If you have transferable skills and experience from sectors such as utilities, infrastructure, construction, energy, transportation, industrial projects or the built environment, we'd love to hear from you.



**About SSE**



SSE’s purpose is to provide energy needed today while building a better world of energy for tomorrow. We do this by developing, building, operating and investing in electricity infrastructure and businesses needed in the energy transition. Our Transforming for Growth investment plan sees us investing £33bn in critical electricity infrastructure across the five years to 2030\.



SSEN Transmission own and operate the electricity transmission network across the north of Scotland. We transport energy from where it is generated to where it is needed, ensuring a safe and reliable electricity supply for the communities we serve. But that's not all – we're upgrading the grid to deliver cleaner, homegrown energy for the future and building a network for net zero to create secure power for generations to come.


**Flexible benefits to fit your life**



Enjoy discounts on private healthcare and gym memberships. Wellbeing benefits like a free online GP and 24/7 counselling service. Interest\-free loans on tech and transport season tickets, or a new bike with our Cycle to Work scheme. As well as generous family entitlements such as maternity and adoption pay, and paternity leave.

SSE will make any reasonable adjustments you need to ensure that your application and experience with us is positive. Please contact shirley\-anne.o'connor@sse.com / 01738 351976 to discuss how we can support you.

jobs.description:
**Senior Animation Engineer \| Unity3D \| Remote \| Stylized Games**
--------------------------------------------------------------------

### **Position Overview**


Beffio is looking for an experienced **Senior Animation Engineer** to join a major game project developed in Unity3D.


This role sits between **Animation, Technical Art, and Engineering**, focusing on the technology, runtime systems, and tools behind high\-quality character animation.


We are looking for someone who understands animation as both a creative workflow and a technical system. You should be comfortable working with animators on controllers, rigs, and pipelines while also discussing runtime architecture, ECS/DOTS, GPU skinning, shaders, performance, and C\# implementation with engineers.


This is a senior individual contributor role with significant **R\&D and technical ownership**, taking ideas from early prototypes through production\-ready systems that can be used and maintained by the wider team.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Develop and optimize animation runtime systems in Unity.
* Work with state machines, blend trees, layers, masks, root motion, animation events, and compression.
* Develop or integrate data\-oriented animation solutions using ECS/DOTS, Jobs, Burst, and baking workflows.
* Explore GPU skinning, deformation, compute shaders, vertex shaders, and vertex animation techniques.
* Build Unity editor tools, validators, asset processors, and production workflows for animation teams.
* Support rigging, skeleton, skinning, and FBX workflows between Maya or Blender and Unity.
* Profile and optimize animation systems across mobile hardware.
* Collaborate closely with Animators, Technical Artists, Gameplay Engineers, and Rendering Engineers.
* Take technical R\&D from prototype to production\-ready feature.
* Establish clean documentation, workflows, and technical standards for the wider team.

**Requirements**

Dit ga je doen

Heb jij een passie voor softwareontwikkeling en krijg je energie van werken in een dynamische, hectische én gezellige omgeving? Wil jij jouw kennis en ervaring inzetten voor innovatieve softwareoplossingen binnen Geografische Informatie Systemen (GIS)? Dan zijn wij van DICTU op zoek naar jou!

Als Full-stack Developer binnen het GIS Cluster werk je aan applicaties met een GIS-component. Je maakt deel uit van een Agile/Scrumteam waarin je samen met collega-ontwikkelaars en klanten werkt aan nieuwe functionaliteiten op basis van user stories. In sprints van drie weken zorg je ervoor dat software zorgvuldig wordt ontwikkeld, getest en beheerd. Daarbij heb je ook aandacht voor Life Cycle Management en Informatiebeveiliging. Je bewaakt mede de kwaliteit, continuïteit en betrouwbaarheid van de software en zorgt ervoor dat het ontwikkelproces soepel verloopt.

Als ontwikkelaar houd je je onder andere bezig met:

ontwikkelen en verbeteren van software en het schrijven van bijbehorende unit tests;
uitvoeren van analyses en ondersteunen van analisten bij het uitzoeken van functionaliteiten;
ondersteunen van Technisch Applicatiebeheer en uitvoeren van andere rollen en taken binnen het DevOps-team;
bijdragen aan verdere professionalisering van applicatieontwikkeling en het naar een hoger niveau brengen van het vakgebied;
vanuit jouw senioriteit het voortouw nemen bij technische en inhoudelijke vraagstukken;
coachen en begeleiden van junior- en medior collega’s;
actief meedenken over en realiseren van toekomstgerichte softwareoplossingen.

Over minimaal HBO werk- en denkniveau beschikt

Ook minimaal 3 jaar ervaring met JavaScript/TypeScript (Angular) hebt

Gewend bent om te werken in een Agile (Scrum) werkomgeving
Ervaring hebt met DevOps, CI/CD en versiebeheer (zoals GitLab)

Daarnaast maak je nog meer kans wanneer je ook:

Ervaring met Docker, Kubernetes, Rancher en/of Helm hebt;
Bekend bent met het ontwikkelen van op GIS-gebaseerde diensten, bij voorkeur met behulp van ESRI-producten;
BPMN en DMN ervaring hebt, bij voorkeur met Camunda.

De competenties die wij zoeken voor deze rol, zijn:

Communicatief sterk
Groot verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel
Initiatief nemend
Samenwerkend
Reflectief en zelf ontwikkelend

Hier kom je te werken

Meer over jouw toekomstige plek in de organisatie

In Nederland is veel grond in gebruik als landbouwgrond, bijvoorbeeld voor het telen van gewassen of als grasland voor de beweiding van vee. Daarnaast is de grond belangrijk voor het uitrijden van meststoffen en voor het in stand houden van bijvoorbeeld natuurwaarden en geeft het ook ruimte voor recreatie. Om het beleid ten aanzien van grondgebruik te ondersteunen ontwikkelt het DICTU GIS Cluster vele verschillende GIS (web)applicaties. De meeste bekende applicaties zijn wel de ‘GO’, ‘Mijnpercelen’ en ‘GGB’ waarmee grote hoeveelheden ruimtelijke informatie wordt ingewonnen, gecontroleerd en beheerd als basis voor subsidieaanvragen van agrarische ondernemers.

De afdeling bestaat uit verschillende DevOps teams die gezamenlijk verantwoordelijk zijn voor het correct functioneren van meerdere GIS applicaties. De teams zijn het hybride werken gewend waarbij minimaal 2 dagen op kantoor gewerkt wordt. De aanpak binnen het DICTU GIS Cluster is daarbij gebaseerd op DevOps/Scrum waarbij door middel van sprints de gevraagde producten iedere drie weken worden opgeleverd door vijf DevOps teams. De DevOps werkwijze vereist natuurlijk dat er verschillende disciplines te vinden zijn in de teams, namelijk: ontwikkelaars, beheerders, testers en operationeel beheerders. En niet onbelangrijk: de meest gebruikte GIS technologie is grotendeels van marktleider ESRI. Het is een gezellig team in Assen. We bedienen onze klanten die in meerdere vestigingen over het land verdeeld zijn, van Roermond tot Deventer, Den Haag en Assen. 

Over Dienst ICT Uitvoering (DICTU)

DICTU is één van de grootste ICT-dienstverleners binnen de Rijksoverheid. Ruim 1.800 gedreven professionals werken in Den Haag, Assen en Zwolle vol enthousiasme en met focus op de klant aan voor Nederland belangrijke IT-systemen. Dat kunnen bedrijfsvoering applicaties, websites en apps zijn, maar ook digitale werkplekken en applicaties op het gebied van subsidies, inspecties en registers. Wij maken daarbij gebruik van moderne technieken en ontwikkelingen zoals Cloud, Mobile en Big Data. Samen met onze klanten kijken we naar de technologische oplossingen voor morgen. Afgestemd op de gebruikers. En continu inspelend op innovaties!

Bijzonderheden

De vacature kan bij voldoende geschikte kandidaten eerder worden gesloten. Na het sluiten van de vacature zullen de vacaturetekst en de gegevens van de vacaturehouder online niet meer zichtbaar zijn. Om te voorkomen dat je deze moet opvragen, verzoeken wij je de vacaturetekst te bewaren.

Ben je nieuw bij DICTU (en de Rijksoverheid)? Dan is de intentie om, na de periode van een tijdelijke arbeidsovereenkomst, de overeenkomst voor onbepaalde tijd voort te zetten. Wanneer je al een vaste overeenkomst bij de Rijksoverheid hebt, dan behoud je deze.

Tot slot vinden wij het belangrijk om een diverse en inclusieve organisatie te zijn. Werken in divers samengestelde teams maakt ons effectiever, innovatiever en het werk leuker. We streven naar een cultuur van gelijkwaardigheid en van veiligheid, waar je kunt zijn wie je bent. Waar je ingezet wordt op je unieke kwaliteiten en waar je gestimuleerd wordt om je talenten verder te ontwikkelen. Do you want to help create the future of healthcare? Our name, Siemens Healthineers, was selected to honor our people who dedicate their energy and passion to this cause. It reflects their pioneering spirit combined with our long history of engineering in the ever-evolving healthcare industry.

We offer you a flexible and dynamic environment with opportunities to go beyond your comfort zone in order to grow personally and professionally. Sounds interesting?

Then come and join our global team as Software System Engineer MRI (f/m/d) to play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and long-term sustainability of our MRI scanner software.

Choose the best place for your work
– Within the scope of this position, it is possible, in consultation with your manager, to work mobile (within Germany) up to an average volume of 60% of the respective working hours.

Even more flexibility?
Mobile working from abroad is possible for up to 30 days a year under certain conditions and in selected countries.

Job location:
Allee am Roethelheimpark 2, 91052 Erlangen

Please attach a motivation letter along with your CV as part of your application.

Your Tasks And Responsibilities

You take a system-wide view of the MRI scanner software and translate complex non-functional requirements into measurable and sustainable engineering solutions.
You drive and own system-level concepts for software integration, reliability, performance, observability, and software obsolescence, ensuring sustainable quality across the entire MRI scanner lifecycle.
You collaborate with international, agile development teams to ensure that component-level solutions support the quality of the overall scanner system.
You establish and evolve automated system-level testing for integration, reliability, performance, and regression detection.
You use system data, telemetry, and technical analysis to identify issues early and continuously improve product quality.
You validate system concepts through prototyping, exploratory technical work, and automated analysis.
You help shape system engineering practices, integration strategies, and technical governance across the development organization.

To find out more about the specific business, have a look at Magnetic Resonance Imaging.

Your Qualifications And Experience

You hold a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related field.
You have many years of experience in designing, developing, and evolving complex software systems
You possess deep expertise in non-functional requirements, including reliability, scalability, performance, observability, maintainability, and seamless system integration.
You bring extensive experience in automated testing, CI/CD, DevOps, and continuous delivery across distributed development teams.
You already have demonstrated technical leadership experience, for example within project environments, where you have driven technical direction and successfully coordinated technical activities.
You have advanced knowledge of technologies such as .NET, C#, SQL, Windows IoT, Azure DevOps, Docker, Azure, and Snowflake, and can effectively apply them in complex business environments.

Your Attributes And Skills

You communicate confidently and effectively in English and can convey complex technical topics to both technical and non-technical stakeholders; German language skills are an advantage.
You combine strong system thinking with a pragmatic, hands-on mindset, maintaining a holistic view of complex products and their interactions across the entire ecosystem.
You excel at translating complex business and quality requirements into scalable engineering solutions, measurable outcomes, and robust validation strategies.
You build trust through your structured and analytical approach, strong communication skills, and ability to collaborate effectively across functions, disciplines, and organizational levels.
You proactively drive alignment, foster technical excellence, and inspire teams through ownership, initiative, and a solution-oriented mindset.

Depending on the experience and qualifications background of the applicant, task enrichment into the area above the general pay scale is possible.

Our Global Team

Siemens Healthineers is a leading global medical technology company. 74,000 dedicated colleagues in over 70 countries are driven to shape the future of healthcare. An estimated 5 million patients across the globe benefit every day from our innovative technologies and services in the areas of diagnostic and therapeutic imaging, laboratory diagnostics and molecular medicine, as well as digital health and enterprise services.

Our Culture

Our culture embraces different perspectives, open debate, and the will to challenge convention. Change is a constant aspect of our work. We aspire to lead the change in our industry rather than just react to it. That’s why we invite you to take on new challenges, test your ideas, and celebrate success.

Check our Careers Site at https://careers.siemens-healthineers.com/global/en

As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.

Siemens Healthineers' recruitment is internally managed, with external support permitted only when a qualified supplier has established a formal contract with us. Remote (Europe & Middle East) | Full-time | 1 Opening

About Our Client

Our client is a fast-growing AI-powered recruitment platform that automates the end-to-end hiring workflow, from candidate sourcing and outreach to AI-driven interviews, pipeline automation, and ATS synchronisation. The platform operates at production scale, running real-time, event-driven pipelines across multiple systems and complex third-party integrations.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We're looking for a Senior Back-End Engineer to own meaningful parts of the platform's API, data, integration, and automation layers. This is a full-time, fully remote role open to candidates based in Europe or the Middle East. You'll join a small, high-ownership team where engineers drive design decisions from schema through to infrastructure, collaborate directly on architecture, and ship independently without heavy process overhead. The stack is TypeScript on Node.js/NestJS, but we'll seriously consider strong engineers from other back-end ecosystems (Go, Java, Python, .NET) who bring the same depth of thinking.

What You'll Do

Design and evolve the GraphQL API layer and the domain services behind it
Build bidirectional integrations with third-party ATS and HR platforms: webhooks, async consumers, idempotency, and retry strategies at scale
Develop event-driven automation pipelines for candidate scoring, interview scheduling, outreach, and rejection flows
Integrate with external vendors across AI interview, telephony, email delivery, and data enrichment APIs
Write and maintain AWS infrastructure-as-code alongside the services that run on it
Design and extend a multi-tenant relational data model and its access control layer

What You Bring

Strong, production-grade back-end experience in TypeScript (Node.js/NestJS), or equivalent depth in Go, Java, Python, or .NET
Solid PostgreSQL (or equivalent) skills: schema design, migrations, query optimisation, and ORMs at scale
Hands-on experience owning a GraphQL API, including schema design and resolver organisation
Event-driven and async architecture experience: SQS or equivalent, retries and back-off, dead-letter handling
Production experience integrating third-party APIs: webhook verification, idempotent writes, rate limits, graceful degradation
Comfort with AWS core services (ECS, SQS, S3, RDS), ideally with CDK, Terraform, or similar
The ability to own a feature end to end, from requirements through data model, API, and infrastructure
Strong operational awareness: logs, traces, metrics, and queries are your everyday tools for investigating live issues
Clear written communication, a considered point of view in design discussions, and a bias toward simplicity

NICE TO HAVE

Python / FastAPI
OpenSearch or Elasticsearch, including hybrid vector/keyword search
Workflow orchestration tools such as Temporal or Inngest
Multi-tenant SaaS design patterns
Experience integrating with ATS, HRIS, or HR-tech platforms

Develop, configure, maintain, and enhance automation and manufacturing software applications.
Design and integrate solutions connected to DCS, MES, historians, databases, and manufacturing systems.
Develop applications and scripts using VBA, PowerShell, C#, SQL, and Git-based version control.
Create functional specifications, software design specifications, and other GxP-compliant engineering documentation.
Support interfaces, data exchange, and integration between OT and IT systems.
Execute software testing, commissioning, qualification, validation, and deployment activities.
Troubleshoot application, interface, database, and system issues and support root cause investigations.
Improve existing applications to increase reliability, performance, maintainability, and user experience.
Ensure compliance with GMP, data integrity, cybersecurity, change management, and software lifecycle requirements.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary project and operational teams throughout the full system lifecycle.

About The Customer

Our client is an international organization within the pharmaceutical and life sciences sector, with a strong presence in Switzerland. The Visp site supports large-scale manufacturing, technology transfer, and major investment in modern facilities and automation infrastructure. Teams work across Engineering, Operations, Quality, Validation, and Project Management to deliver safe, compliant, and reliable solutions. The environment is technically demanding and strongly focused on GMP, operational excellence, and continuous improvement, offering exposure to significant CAPEX projects and advanced automation technologies.

Requirements

Degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
Strong IT and software engineering background, including databases, networking, system integration, and application support.
Experience with manufacturing and automation platforms such as DCS, MES, or data historian systems.
Practical knowledge of VBA, PowerShell, C#, and SQL.
Understanding of software lifecycle management, version control, and structured application support.
Experience working in GMP-regulated environments and preparing GxP-compliant documentation.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis skills.
Fluent English and/or German.

jobs.title: Team Manager Software Development – Backend Services
jobs.description:
TeamViewer provides a leading Digital Workplace platform that connects people with technology—enabling, improving and automating digital processes to make work work better. Our software solutions harness the power of AI and shape the future of digitalization.

We believe that our diverse teams and strong company culture are key to the success of our products and technologies, that hundreds of millions of users around the world and around 645,000 customers across all industries rely on. With more than 1,900 employees worldwide, we celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each individual brings to the table and foster a dynamic work environment where new ideas thrive. Are you ready to join our team and make an impact?

Responsibilities

We are looking for a Team Manager (all genders) to lead the engineering teams building and running the backend services that power TeamViewer products. This is a leader-of-leaders role
: you will manage and develop a group of Team Leads, growing their leadership capability so they can run high-performing teams on their own. Alongside this, you will shape the technical and organizational direction of these services, and ensure they remain secure, reliable and scalable as our products and customer base grow. You will work closely with Product Management, Architecture, Security and other R&D leaders in an agile, modern environment.

Lead, coach and develop a group of Team Leads, helping them grow as people managers and technical leaders, while supporting engineers directly where needed.
Build a strong leadership bench: set clear expectations for Team Leads, run regular 1:1s and feedback cycles, and identify and grow future leaders within the teams.
Create alignment across your Team Leads so that multiple agile teams work toward shared goals with consistent practices.
Own the delivery and long-term evolution of the backend services that power our products, balancing new capabilities with stability, security and technical debt.
Drive roadmap execution with Product Management and other stakeholders, translating business needs into clear team priorities.
Ensure our backend meets high standards for availability, performance, security and compliance.
Collaborate with product and engineering teams across the company on integration, shared standards and scalable solutions.
Oversee capacity planning, resource allocation and hiring to support growth and delivery.
Promote engineering excellence and agile best practices across development, testing, deployment and operations.
Support the professional development of your team through coaching, feedback and career planning.
Act as a key link between engineering and senior management, translating technical progress and risk into business-relevant updates.
Champion a culture of open communication, psychological safety, ownership and accountability.

Requirements

A university or college degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
8+ years of experience in software engineering, with a solid understanding of modern development practices.
4+ years in a managerial role within software development, ideally in an agile environment.
1+ years of experience leading leaders (Team Leads or Engineering Managers), including coaching them, managing their performance and growing them into stronger leaders.
Proven track record of leading multiple teams building and operating backend services in production through a layer of Team Leads.
Strong understanding of distributed systems, software architecture, scalability, and the full development and operations lifecycle.
Experience with services that have high requirements for security, reliability and backward compatibility is a strong plus.
Experience in strategic planning, team building and performance management, including hiring and onboarding Team Leads.
Excellent communication and leadership skills, with the ability to influence and inspire across teams and stakeholders.
Fluent in English (spoken and written); Portuguese or German is a plus.

What We Offer

Onsite Onboarding in our HQ office for an optimal start
Great compensation and benefits packages including company achievement bonus or sales bonus and regular salary reviews
Public transport friendly offices
Special terms for local gyms
Access to Corporate Benefits platform with many discounts
Regular Team events and company-wide celebrations
Open door policy, no dress code rules, frequent all Hands and Leadership Lunches
Hybrid and Flexible work time
Work From Abroad Program allowing up to 40 days of work outside your contracting country
We celebrate diversity as one of core values, join and drive one of the c-a-r-e initiatives together with us!

TeamViewer is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome and supported. We C-A-R-E and understand that our diverse, values-driven culture makes us stronger. As we continue to grow as a company, we also focus on enabling our employees to grow both personally and professionally. We are proud to have an open and embracing workplace environment that will empower you to be your best no matter your gender, civil or family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

If you require any accommodations or adjustments during the application or hiring process, including interview or onboarding support, please reach out to your Talent Acquisition Partner, who will be happy to support you.
